description: The file defines a Spring configuration class 'JmsManagerConfig' that sets up JMS messaging flow for outbound requests within the Apache Fineract infrastructure. It registers beans for integration flow, uses dependency injection for required components, and includes conditional configuration based on JmsManagerCondition.

classes.name: JmsManagerConfig
classes.description: Spring configuration class that defines integration flow for outbound JMS messaging, conditioned on JmsManagerCondition.

methods.name: outboundFlow
methods.description: Defines an IntegrationFlow bean that intercepts outbound requests, logs at DEBUG level, and handles them via JMS outbound adapter with configuration from fineractProperties.
